cases.refreshed: Do you want to build your English-language skills and your confidence? English Language Learners (ELL) can increase their English skills with our tutor in a welcoming and respectful environment for adult learners. Sessions take place every 2nd and 4th Tuesdays. Topics may include learning new vocabulary, practicing pronunciation, and basic grammar. Suggested for English language learners with little to no experience. Space is limited and registration is required. Please stop by the Vineland Library or call us at (408) 808-3000 to register. Vineland's English Learning series: ELL Beginning English: A beginner program for learners with limited English skills; approximately levels 0-2; ELL Grammar and Vocabulary Club: An intermediate program for learners that know some English but want to learn more complex English; approximately levels 2-3; ELL Conversation Club: An advanced program for learners to practice speaking and listening while also learning about American culture and idioms; approximately levels 3-4; ELL Writing Club: A program where high beginners to advanced level English language learners can learn and practice their English writing skills; approximately levels 2-4.

cases.refreshed: Love to craft, love to eat? It might sound like a funny combination, but it's really not. Food Crafting is a thing, and we do it every second Tuesday of the month. Make an epic-looking treat and eat it, too. November's Recipe is: Miniature Fruit Pies! Who doesn't love a sweet, fruity treat in honor of the holiday season, or whenever you want. Who's turning down pie? Pick a flavor, craft your shell and bake. Supplies are limited! Free Program. No registration required. Middle and High School students welcome.

cases.refreshed: Stop by the library and get crafty! We will have various art and craft supplies, like markers, paper, scissors, glues, vinyl, fabric, yarn, etc., available to use to create whatever you like. Make something for a friend or for yourself. Better yet, bring a friend! You can also learn about and try out our crafting equipment, such as: 2 Sewing Machines; Cricut Explore Air 2; Cricut Maker; Cricut Easy Press. Don't know what to make? No problem! We'll have some suggestions for projects to try out. Be creative, de-stress, and have fun! Free. No registration. This program is generously sponsored by the Friends of the Vineland Branch Library.

Recommended for ages 5-12. November Events: November 3 - Frank Buffalo Hyde (drawing); November 10 - Rangoli (Diwali craft); November 17 - Theresa Secord (weaving); November 24 - Jaune Quick-to-See Smith (map art). Free. Registration not required.
